salvo: salvo14/mig/s6 (9 Nov 2026), lot k-openai-2 (c2-openai). KernelCraft formal verification of GPU kernels by agents (Level 1: twelve tasks per target language PTX, CUDA, HIP). GPT-6 Luna column of Table 2: pass rate over the twelve tasks per target language (3 measures) with the mean input and output tokens over the proven tasks (millions) attached as usage of the same measure. The per-task pass/fail/budget strings, per-task token counts (Table 11), tokens per stage (Table 12) and the failure analysis (Table 13) are categorical or counts of runs: kept as notes, not measures. Effort xhigh for the backward and proof agents (Table 10 flags --backward-effort xhigh, --proof-effort xhigh; --other-effort default (xhigh)); spending ceiling 50 USD per verification and a round cap of 16 (Tables 7 and 10); no provider named. A failed run spends to its budget, so the token means cover the proven tasks only.
agent: convertisseur k-openai-2 (Sonnet 5.5), lecture ligne par ligne du fichier de recherche et de la copie
